chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Usman, from Al-Halabi and Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He was asked about the Salat (prayer) upon the child, when should Salat be prayed upon him? He said: When he has reasoning (acquires intellect). I said: When does the Salat become obligatory upon him? So he said: When he is a son of six years of age; and the Fasting is when he can endure it.
ai.seo_question: At what age does prayer become obligatory for a child in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between the recommended prayer over a child (Salat al-Mustahabb) and the obligation of prayer upon the child themselves (Salat al-Wajib). The Imam establishes the age of six as the threshold for obligatory prayer, while linking the capacity for fasting to physical endurance rather than a fixed age, reflecting the Shia emphasis on gradual religious maturation (Tadarruj). This hadith serves as a foundational text for the fiqh of childhood obligations, highlighting the interplay between cognitive maturity ('Aql) and physical capability in determining religious duties.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Al Halby and Zurara, 
from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having been asked about the Salaat upon the boys, when should Salaat be prayed upon him?’ Heasws said: ‘When he has reasoning, the Salaat (would be prayed)’. I said, ‘When would the Salaat be Obligated upon him?’ So heasws said: ‘When he was a son of six years of age; and the Fasting is when he can endure it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Halabiy and Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

was asked about Salah (prayer) of a child. He (the Imam) said, ‘There is Salah (prayer) for him when he is able to understand it (Salah (prayer)).’ I (the narrator) then asked, ‘When it becomes obligatory for him? He (the Imam) said, ‘It is when he is six years old and there is fasting on him when he is able to fast.’”
